title: Dashboard data is generated, not committed
context: Browsers block a page opened from disk from reading neighbouring JSON files, and a committed bundle would conflict on every merge.
decision: The CLI writes .repostate/data.js after each change; it is gitignored. Git hooks rebuild it after pulls, and the page can also load the folder through a file picker.
consequences: A fresh clone needs one build (or the hooks) before the dashboard shows data.
author: noreply@anthropic.com
